(async () => { const a = await import('/js/core/assets.js'); const out = {}; for (const g of ['m', 'f']) { const lib = a.decodeAnims(await a.bin('assets/baked/anims_' + g + '.bin')); for (const [k, c] of Object.entries(lib)) { const names = new Set(c.tracks.map(t => t.name)); const miss = ['Bip01_Spine2', 'Bip01_Neck', 'Bip01_Head', 'Bip01_LEye', 'Bip01_REye', 'Bip01_L_UpperArm', 'Bip01_Pelvis'].filter(b => !names.has(b + '.quaternion')); if (miss.length) out[k] = miss.join(','); } out['#' + g] = Object.keys(lib).length; } return JSON.stringify(out); })()
